aboutMe.title: About Me
aboutMe.description: I am a 4th-year Computer Engineering student and Full Stack Developer with experience in web management systems. I work with JavaScript, Node.js, and React, creating applications with solid logic and attractive interfaces. I've developed projects like a CRM for repairs with customer management and automated WhatsApp integration, and a system for cross-referencing e-commerce data with Mercado Pago, generating Excel reports. I am passionate about creating without limits, and my goal is to lead a development team, inspiring others to build innovative solutions.
